{{Quote|No, don't look at me! Act casual. I found a listening device in the plants. I think the gardening staff is compromised. They'll catch on if I poke around, but they won't suspect you!|The guard|<ref name="Listening" />}}
A '''Senate Tower guard''' believed that the [[Senate Building gardening staff|gardening staff]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] was compromised after finding a [[Listening device/Legends|listening device]] in a [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. The [[Senate Guard/Legends|guard]] went on to recruit an individual to search for additional listening devices by searching plants and scanning senate employees.<ref name="Listening" />
